title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - GTIN8ID
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/GTIN8ID . GTIN-8 (EAN/UCC-8) is an 8-digit number used predominately outside of North America. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasGTIN8IDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GTIN8ID'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasGTIN8IDValue.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasGTIN8IDValue'. The value of the GTIN-8 identifier as an 8-digit string.
